params.name: offset
params.description: The number of results to skip before returning values.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results to return.

params.name: sorts
params.description: A list of field names to sort by, and whether to show results as ascending or descending. Formatted as `<fieldName>:asc` or `<fieldName>:desc`.

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: The Workspace ID to filter for. The API returns details for all environment objects belonging only to this specified Workspace.

params.name: deploymentId
params.description: The Deployment ID to filter for. The API returns details for all environment objects belonging only to this specified Deployment.

params.name: objectType
params.description: The environment object type to filter for. The API returns details for all environment objects belonging only to this specified object type.

params.name: objectKey
params.description: The environment object key to filter for. The API returns details for all environment objects belonging only to the specified object key.

params.name: showSecrets
params.description: If true, returns the actual values of fields of type secret in the API response.

params.name: resolveLinked
params.description: Resolve and return the environment objects linked to the specified Deployment or Workspace in the API response.
